title: 自研 Harness：从三次 Request 改进到两次

audiences: 正在开发自研 Agent，希望定位失败原因并验证改进的开发者
需要检查 OpenAI Responses 或 Anthropic Messages 兼容层的 Harness 作者
第一次使用 pma observe、但不需要专用 adapter 的用户
teaching_contract.question: 怎样把一次多余重试追到上行工具 schema，并用同一输入证明 Harness 改动已经生效？
teaching_contract.takeaway: 先用 pma observe 捕获旧版的空参数、错误结果与重试，再从 Tools / Raw 确认 path 未设为必填；修正 schema 后重跑同一任务，用 3→2 次 Request 和真实上行字段建立人工改进证据。
explicit_limits: The generic bridge proves captured HTTP exchange, not Harness-specific permission semantics.
It does not infer Skill, command, compaction, resume, or subagent behavior from the Source name.
Deterministic responses demonstrate Viewer and protocol behavior, not remote model quality.
The 3-to-2 Request change is one deterministic scenario result, not an automated PMA experiment score or a universal model-quality claim.
Header redaction does not make arbitrary request bodies safe to publish.
OpenAI Responses wire data uses typed Items; assistant and tool labels shown by the Viewer are a semantic projection, not native roles on function_call or function_call_output Items.
The chapter does not claim that every OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible service implements the official schema perfectly.

viewer.capture_mode: reproducible bundled Chromium CDP capture script

facts: All three Sources were generated by the real pma observe wrapper.
harness-before contains one Turn, three Requests, an empty read_file call, a matched path-is-required result, one retry, and one final answer.
harness-after contains one Turn, two Requests, one read_file call with path README.md, one matched result, and one final answer.
The improved request body contains required path, additionalProperties false, and strict true; the baseline request does not.
The Anthropic boundary Source contains one Turn, two Requests, one list_directory call, one matched result, and one final answer.
The OpenAI Source uses /v1/responses and the Anthropic Source uses /v1/messages.
The child-only base URL override disappears after the child exits; both Sources are stopped and retain their Trace.
The Source label does not select a protocol; protocol projection comes from captured wire evidence.
Authorization and x-api-key headers are persisted as [REDACTED:header].

review_notes: The demo was regenerated with the child cwd fixed to /tmp/pma-custom-harness-demo/public-project; all ten current raw frames show only that disposable path.
OpenAI frames use the Codex theme and Anthropic frames use the Claude theme.
All screenshots use an exact 1920x1080 browser viewport with no document overflow.
Right-pane tabs remain comfortably spaced at full desktop width instead of filling the row.
The before sequence progressively frames the Source, mechanism flow, two call/result pairs, empty arguments, the path-is-required result, and the retry without crossing readable text.

The Raw comparison frames the whole tool definition before separately emphasizing strict; the improved frame keeps the description visible while required, additionalProperties, and strict remain inside one coherent schema group.
Small entry points use a badge and click ripple; broad evidence uses a lightly tinted rounded frame with even breathing room.
Every named review point and generated transition state was visually inspected in both review contact sheets, with key frames opened at original 1920x1080 size.
No arrows were added because focus frames and progressive numbering provide a clearer route without crossing readable content.

video_master.stream: H.264 video only; no audio stream, subtitle stream, or webpage subtitle layer
video_master.comparison_crop: 1920x900, excluding the approved webpage-subtitle region because the picture master intentionally hides that layer
qa_notes: All 25 frames were re-extracted from the final MP4 at the corrected timeline review points and visually inspected at original size.
The three handoff checkpoints contain the intended short overlap; completed states keep only the new marker unless an explicit comparison requires the old marker to remain dimmed.
OpenAI input Items and the downstream Assistant message are framed separately; Anthropic tool_use remains dimmed only to compare it with the later tool_result.
The maximum frame-mean difference occurs in the Raw header-redaction scene and was confirmed as normal browser/encoder rendering variation rather than a shifted annotation.
